blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defending champion Criss Cross and National University-Archipelago Builders kept their share of the lead in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference after taking down separate rivals on Sunday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Criss Cross, gunning for a three-peat, turned to five-time Conference MVP Jude Garcia anew to stave off Alpha Insurance, 25-22, 21-25, 25-21, 25-19. Garcia drilled 21 kills to finish with 22 points. He was backstopped by newcomer Amil Pacinio with 16 points, as setter Ariel Cacao continued to shine as a King Cruncher with 20 excellent sets. READ: Spikers’ Turf: Kampton atones for […]...
